parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Nitrates decompose when they are heated. When hydrated copper( II ) nitrate is heated, oxygen gas is produced.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the equation for the decomposition of hydrated copper( II ) nitrate. 2Cu(NO 3 ) 2 •3H 2 O → .....CuO + .....NO 2 + O 2 + .....H 2 O [2]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Hydrated zinc sulfate gives off water when it is heated. ZnSO 4 • x H 2 O(s) → ZnSO 4 (s) + x H 2 O(g) A student does an experiment to determine the value of x in ZnSO 4 • x H 2 O. step 1 The student weighs a sample of hydrated zinc sulfate. step 2 The student heats the sample of hydrated zinc sulfate. step 3 The student weighs the solid after heating. step 4 The student repeats step 2 and step 3 until the mass of solid after heating is constant.

ms.label: 5(d)(i)
ms.text: (To ensure that) all the water is given off

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) In an experiment, 0.574 g of ZnSO 4 • x H 2 O is heated until the mass is constant. The mass of ZnSO 4 that remains is 0.322 g.
